description: Implementation of TTY serial interface handling UART interrupts, buffering, and read/write operations in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: tty_irq_input_hook
methods.description: Handles incoming UART data, buffers it, and signals availability.

methods.name: tty_putchar
methods.description: Buffers a character for transmission and enables UART TX interrupt.

methods.name: tty_write
methods.description: Writes data to UART, either buffered or unbuffered.

methods.name: tty_getchar
methods.description: Retrieves a character from the receive buffer.

methods.name: tty_read_unbuf
methods.description: Reads data directly from UART without buffering.

methods.name: tty_read
methods.description: Reads data from UART, using buffer if configured.

methods.name: tty_init
methods.description: Initializes the tty serial interface with UART device.

methods.name: tty_set_rx_buf
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer for UART.

methods.name: tty_set_tx_buf
methods.description: Sets the transmit buffer for UART.
